    Fischbacher §5.3, Case B: the minimal chain at the valley #

    If the zero t-path and the s-path of a segment of a good walk start with different arrows γ_t, γ_s out of the valley c, then c is minimal in the hull, the rest of the closed walk joins the targets of γ_t and γ_s away from c, and the separation criterion at c gives a chain of links from γ_t to γ_s with bounds in the hull; we take a minimal one (ZWalk.Good.exists_minChain).
